title: Synthesis, characterization, and DNA binding of Ni(II), Cu(II), and Zn(II) complexes with a novel N,O-bidentate acylhydrazone.
authors: Msumange, Aujenus Albert; Moreira, Jeniffer Meyer; Msumange, Deus Albert; Souza, Rafael Aparecido Carvalho; Martins, Mario Machado; Schwalm, Cristiane Storck; da Silva Dorneles, Luana; Trindade, Magno Aparecido Goncalves; Rodrigues, Raphael; de Arruda, Eduardo Jose; de Carvalho, Claudio Teodoro
journal: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Ni(II)、Cu(II)、Zn(II)酰腙配合物的合成及其与DNA的沟槽结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、对接为辅，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: A novel acylhydrazone Schiff base ligand, 2-fluoro-N'-[(1E,2E)-3-(2-methoxyphenyl)prop-2-en-1-ylidene]benzohydrazide (L), was synthesized and coordinated with Ni(II), Cu(II), and Zn(II) ions. The resulting complexes were characterized using TGA-DSC, FTIR/ATR, HRESIMS, (1)H NMR, PXRD, elemental analysis, and complexometric titration, confirming a 1:2 metal-to-ligand stoichiometry and the formation of polycrystalline compounds. Coordination occurs via an N,O-bidentate mode through the enolic oxygen and azomethine nitrogen, forming stable five-membered chelate rings. Thermal analysis revealed high stability, with decomposition leading to the metal oxides, while PXRD indicated crystallite sizes in the 20-50 nm range. Spectroscopic DNA-binding studies via UV-Vis and fluorescence spectroscopy demonstrated moderate hypochromism (20-41%) without significant bathochromic shifts, yielding intrinsic binding constants (K(b)) on the order of 10(4) L mol(-1). Viscosity measurements and ethidium bromide displacement assays corroborated a predominantly non-intercalative groove-binding mode. Molecular docking simulations supported these experimental findings, revealing plausible minor-groove binding poses stabilized by hydrogen bonding, halogen contacts, pi-anion interactions, and hydrophobic interactions, consistent with the observed DNA-binding behavior. BSA fluorescence quenching studies suggested a predominant static quenching mechanism, with binding constants in the range of 10(4)-10(5) M(-1), indicative of moderate, reversible ground-state complex formation with serum albumin and suggesting relevant protein-binding behavior. The combined experimental and theoretical data demonstrate that metal coordination enhances DNA affinity and modulates biomolecular interactions, particularly for the Ni(II) complex, highlighting the potential of this new acylhydrazone framework as a platform for DNA-binding coordination compounds and related studies of biomolecular interactions.
abstract_zh: 合成了一种新型酰腙席夫碱配体，2-氟-N'-[(1E,2E)-3-(2-甲氧基苯基)丙-2-烯-1-亚基]苯甲酰肼（L），并使其与Ni(II)、Cu(II)和Zn(II)离子配位。所得配合物通过TGA-DSC、FTIR/ATR、HRESIMS、(1)H NMR、PXRD、元素分析和络合滴定进行表征，确认了1:2金属-配体化学计量比及多晶化合物的形成。配位通过烯醇氧和偶氮甲碱氮的N,O-双齿模式发生，形成稳定的五元螯合环。热分析显示高稳定性，分解最终生成金属氧化物，而PXRD表明晶粒尺寸在20-50 nm范围内。通过UV-Vis和荧光光谱进行的谱学DNA结合研究表明，存在中等程度的减色效应（20-41%），无明显红移，固有结合常数（K(b)）约为10(4) L mol(-1)。粘度测量和溴化乙锭置换实验证实了以非嵌入沟槽结合为主的模式。分子对接模拟支持这些实验发现，揭示了由氢键、卤素接触、π-阴离子相互作用和疏水相互作用稳定的可能小沟结合姿态，与观察到的DNA结合行为一致。BSA荧光猝灭研究表明以静态猝灭机制为主，结合常数在10(4)-10(5) M(-1)范围内，表明与血清白蛋白形成中等强度、可逆的基态复合物，并提示相关的蛋白质结合行为。综合实验和理论数据表明，金属配位增强了DNA亲和力并调节了生物分子相互作用，尤其是Ni(II)配合物，突显了这种新型酰腙框架作为DNA结合配位化合物及相关生物分子相互作用研究平台的潜力。
